title: Refunds & cancellation
text: Annual subscriptions are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of the initial purchase, provided fewer than 5 projects have been exported. Refund requests must be submitted by the workspace owner through Settings > Billing > Request refund. Approved refunds return to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Monthly plans are non-refundable; cancellation prevents the next renewal and access continues until the end of the paid period.

title: Subscription renewals
text: Renewal charges are non-refundable, except duplicate charges or billing errors. Contact billing support within 30 days of a duplicate charge and include both invoice numbers. Cancel a subscription at least 24 hours before renewal in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. Cancelling does not delete workspace data.

title: Plans & workspace limits
text: The Starter plan includes 3 seats, 10 projects and 5 GB of storage. The Pro plan includes 20 seats, unlimited projects and 100 GB of storage. The Enterprise plan supports custom seat counts and storage, SAML single sign-on and audit logs. Storage limits apply to the whole workspace, not to each seat. Paid plan upgrades take effect immediately and charges are prorated.

title: SAML single sign-on setup
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. A workspace administrator must verify the company domain, then enter the identity provider metadata URL in Settings > Security > Single sign-on. Set the NameID format to email address and match the primary email in SourceDesk. Test with a non-owner account before enforcing SSO. Keep a recovery administrator account with SSO bypass enabled.

title: Troubleshoot SSO sign-in
text: The SSO_403 error means the identity provider email does not match the primary email in the workspace. Ask an administrator to check the SAML NameID email, verify domain ownership and confirm that the user is assigned to the SourceDesk application in the identity provider. A clock difference greater than 5 minutes can also invalidate the assertion. Do not disable SSO for the whole organization to resolve one user’s sign-in issue.

title: API rate limits
text: API limits are 60 requests per minute for Starter, 600 for Pro and 3,000 for Enterprise, per workspace. An HTTP 429 response includes a Retry-After header in seconds. Wait for that interval, then retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Repeated immediate retries extend throttling. Bulk exports share the same workspace rate limit.

title: API keys & authentication
text: Workspace administrators can create and revoke API keys in Settings > Developers > API keys. Send the key in the Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. For zero-downtime rotation, create a second key, update the integration, verify successful requests and then revoke the old key. Never paste API keys into support tickets or client-side source code.

title: Export troubleshooting
text: If an export stays queued for more than 10 minutes, check the service status page, then retry once. An EXPORT_413 error means the source file exceeds the 500 MB upload limit. Reduce the source file size and upload it again. For failed PDF exports, remove unsupported fonts and use embedded fonts. Contact support with the export job ID if a second attempt fails.

title: Workspace deletion & recovery
text: Only workspace owners can delete a workspace. Deleted workspaces enter a 30-day recovery period; an owner can request restoration through support during that period. After 30 days, project data is permanently removed from active systems. Encrypted backups expire within an additional 60 days. Cancelling a subscription does not trigger workspace deletion.

title: Data residency & encryption
text: Enterprise customers can choose the United States or European Union region at workspace creation. Moving an existing workspace between regions requires a support-assisted migration. Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or later. Regional hosting covers project content; billing records follow the payment processor’s applicable retention rules.

title: Support service levels
text: Starter support has a first-response target of 2 business days. Pro support has a target of 8 business hours. Enterprise priority-one incidents have a 1-hour first-response target, available 24/7. Priority one means a production outage affecting all users with no workaround. These are response targets, not guaranteed resolution times.

title: Invite and manage teammates
text: Workspace owners and administrators can invite teammates from Settings > Members. Invitations expire after 7 days. If an invitation has expired, revoke it and send a new invitation. A member cannot join when the workspace has reached its plan’s seat limit. Guests can view shared projects but cannot export or change billing settings.

title: Offline access & sync
text: Offline editing is supported in the desktop application for projects opened during the last 7 days. New projects, invitations and exports require an internet connection. Changes sync when connectivity returns. If two people edit the same object offline, the application keeps both versions and asks the user to resolve the conflict.

title: Refund policy (archived)
text: Annual subscriptions are refundable within 30 days of purchase. This policy is archived and must not be used for current support decisions.
